verdict.rationale: The CLI (bw list/create/edit/delete) and Public API expose scriptable, item-level access that can be chained for bulk operations, and import/export functions handle whole-vault bulk transfers of many items at once; community evidence (bw list dumping the entire vault) confirms bulk read actually works. However, there is no first-party documentation of a dedicated bulk-edit/bulk-tag/bulk-delete command or batch endpoint — bulk operations require the user to script them themselves rather than a built-in bulk API. Missing for 10: documented native bulk-update/bulk-delete commands, batch API endpoints for many items, and independent hands-on confirmation of large-scale automated edits succeeding.
